name: BINGO
summary: BINGO develops background-rejection technologies for molybdenum-100 and tellurium-130 cryogenic double-beta searches. MINI-BINGO is its underground demonstrator, related to but distinct from CROSS and CUPID.
detection_principle: Heat-and-light bolometers use Li2MoO4 scintillation or the weak Cherenkov light of TeO2 for particle identification. Low-mass detector supports, sensitive Neganov-Trofimov-Luke light sensors and a cold BGO active veto target surface, gamma and pile-up backgrounds.

status.label: Research and development
status.evidence: Two prototype modules were tested at Canfranc. The September 2026 report describes commissioned cryogenic infrastructure at Modane and a first MINI-BINGO physics campaign foreseen for autumn 2026, not yet confirmed by that report.

science_scope: A neutrinoless decay would violate lepton number. Half-life sensitivity is a forecast unless explicitly reported as an experimental limit; its interpretation as an effective Majorana mass depends on the decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements.
